title: One-to-Many Transfer
description: Send tokens & NFTs from one wallet to multiple addresses in batch

seo.page_title: One-to-Many Transfer - Batch Send Tokens & NFTs to Multiple Wallets | BiuBiu Tools
seo.page_description: Send tokens and NFTs from one wallet to multiple addresses in batch. Support for ETH, ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155 across multiple blockchain networks.
seo.keywords: one to many transfer, batch send, airdrop, token transfer, NFT transfer, multi-send, batch transfer, ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155, crypto distribution, web3 tools
seo.webapp_description: Batch send tokens and NFTs from one wallet to multiple recipients across various blockchain networks
seo.howto_name: How to Batch Send Tokens & NFTs to Multiple Wallets
seo.howto_description: Complete guide to sending tokens and NFTs from one wallet to multiple recipient addresses
seo.howto_tool_2: Sufficient token balance and gas fees
seo.step_1_text: Click the "Connect Wallet" button and connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, etc.) to the application. This wallet will be the source of tokens for distribution.
seo.step_1_description: Link your Web3 wallet as the source wallet
seo.step_2_text: Verify that required smart contracts (WETH and TokenDistribution) are deployed on the selected network. These contracts enable batch distribution functionality.
seo.step_3_text: Choose which token to distribute (native token, ERC20, or NFT), set the distribution mode (equal amounts or custom per recipient), and specify the amount per recipient or total amount.
seo.step_4_text: Add recipient wallet addresses by manually entering them, uploading a CSV file, or pasting a list. Optionally set custom amounts for each recipient.
seo.step_5_text: Review the distribution summary including total amount, recipient count, and estimated gas costs. Confirm and execute the batch distribution. Sign each transaction with your wallet.
seo.feature_1: Connect Web3 wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet)
seo.feature_2: Support multiple networks (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism)
seo.feature_3: Send native tokens (ETH, BNB, MATIC), ERC20 tokens, and NFTs (ERC721, ERC1155)
seo.feature_4: Equal distribution or custom amounts per recipient
seo.feature_5: Import recipients via CSV, paste, or manual entry

faqs.one_to_many_explanation: One-to-Many Transfer allows you to send tokens or NFTs from a single wallet to multiple recipient addresses in batch. It's ideal for airdrops, payroll, rewards distribution, and any scenario where you need to send assets to many addresses efficiently.
faqs.what_tokens_supported: What types of tokens are supported?
faqs.tokens_supported_explanation: We support native tokens (ETH, BNB, MATIC, etc.), ERC20 tokens (USDT, USDC, etc.), and NFTs including both ERC721 and ERC1155 standards.
faqs.equal_distribution_explanation: In equal distribution mode, you specify an amount per recipient, and every address receives the same amount. The total is calculated automatically based on the number of recipients.
faqs.custom_amounts_explanation: In custom amounts mode, you can specify different amounts for each recipient. This is useful when different addresses should receive different quantities.
faqs.how_to_import_recipients: How can I import recipient addresses?
faqs.import_recipients_explanation: You can add recipients by: 1) Manual entry one by one, 2) Bulk paste a list of addresses, or 3) Upload a CSV file with addresses and optional amounts.
faqs.networks_supported_explanation: Currently we support Ethereum Mainnet, Polygon, BSC (Binance Smart Chain), Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism. More networks will be added in the future.
